result.brief: 提出 GenRM-Flow，将偏好微调后的流匹配视频生成器本身作为过程感知奖励模型，用连续时间速度预测误差在噪声潜空间读出奖励，替代外部 VLM 打分器并提升下游视频生成。
result.reason: Derives a process-aware reward from flow-matching video generators' velocity-prediction errors in latent space, improving video generation alignment without auxiliary reward networks.
